description: For those I have not yet met, I’m Luke Searle. I grew up in the Heber Valley, am now a Wasatch High and Wasatch CAPS teacher (& Turning Point Advisor), Wasatch County Councilman, and a candidate for Utah House District 59. I want to share my campaign launch video and explain why I’m running.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Luke Searle
title: About Me — Vote Luke Searle for Utah House District 59
